Upon Julia’s Hair Filled with Dew

Robert Herrick (1591–1674)

D
EW
 sat on Julia’s hair,
And spangled too,
Like leaves that laden are
With trembling dew:
Or glittered to my sight
As when the beams
Have their reflected light
Danced by the streams.
